title: provider_announce input
description: The adapter's agent.json and endpoint; a changed file is a new version waiting for its publisher's review.

endpoint.description: The adapter's public MCP endpoint. Empty, or left out, for an agent that only uses other agents' services: it has no address.

config.description: The adapter's agent.json, ${NAME} expanded and local settings stripped.

proof_key.description: Endpoint proof v2: HMAC-SHA256(agent key, 'ekl-endpoint-proof-v2') as lowercase hex, computed where the key is. Sent once; once the network holds it, v1 proofs and v1 enroll authority for the agent are refused.

upstream_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 (hex) of ekl-json-1 of the declared tools of the upstream tools/list, sorted by name, each as {name, description, inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations} with absent members null (PROTOCOL.md §5.1; vectors/upstream-fingerprint.json).
